description: Main API implementation for a certification management system built with FastAPI. Defines routes for health checks, creating and retrieving certification jobs, handling webhooks from GitLab and Airflow, managing mappings and metadata, and orchestrating background tasks.

classes.name: HealthResponse
classes.description: Response schema for health check endpoints.

classes.name: CertificationRunResponse
classes.description: Schema for representing certification job responses.

classes.name: MappingResponse
classes.description: Schema for branch to environment mapping responses.

classes.name: GitLabWebhookPush
classes.description: Schema for parsing GitLab webhook push events.

classes.name: AirflowTaskEvent
classes.description: Schema for receiving Airflow DAG/task event updates.

classes.name: RepositoryRef
classes.description: Schema representing repository reference details in webhook payloads.

classes.name: TriggerCertificationRequest
classes.description: Request schema for initiating a certification job.

classes.name: MetadataUpsert
classes.description: Schema for creating or updating metadata items.

methods.name: None _background_trigger_orchestration(run_id: str)
methods.description: Background task to trigger orchestration of certification job via Airflow DAGs.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse create_certification( payload: TriggerCertificationRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new certification job.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse get_certification( run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve certification job details by run_id.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse patch_certification( run_id: str, payload: PatchCertificationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )
methods.description: Patch and update an existing certification job.

methods.name: List[MappingResponse] get_mappings( provider: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by provider"), project_id: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by project_id"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: List branch-environment mappings with optional filters.

methods.description: List metadata items with optional filters.
